actor: Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords
actor_quote: Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords
scope_text: upon request by any individual to gain access to his record or to any information pertaining to him which is contained in the system
scope_quotes: (d) Access to Records.— Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords shall—

(1) upon request by any individual to gain access to his record or to any information pertaining to him which is contained in the system, permit him and upon his request, a person of his own choosing to accompany him, to review the record and have a copy made of all or any portion thereof in a form comprehensible to him, except that the agency may require the individual to furnish a written statement authorizing discussion of that individual’s record in the accompanying person’s presence;

actor: Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords
actor_quote: Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords
scope_text: upon an individual's request to amend a record pertaining to him
scope_quotes: (d) Access to Records.— Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords shall—
(2) permit the individual to request amendment of a record pertaining to him and—
choice_text: The agency must promptly execute one of two alternatives: either (1) make the requested correction of any portion the individual believes is not accurate, relevant, timely, or complete; or (2) inform the individual of its refusal to amend the record, the reason, established review procedures before the agency head or designated officer, and the official's name and business address.
alternative_quotes: (i) make any correction of any portion thereof which the individual believes is not accurate, relevant, timely, or complete; or

(ii) inform the individual of its refusal to amend the record in accordance with his request, the reason for the refusal, the procedures established by the agency for the individual to request a review of that refusal by the head of the agency or an officer designated by the head of the agency, and the name and business address of that official;
summary: Each agency that maintains a system of records must, upon an individual's request to amend a record pertaining to him, promptly either: (i) make any correction of any portion thereof which the individual believes is not accurate, relevant, timely, or complete; or (ii) inform the individual of its refusal to amend the record in accordance with his request, the reason for the refusal, the procedures established by the agency for the individual to request a review of that refusal by the head of the agency or an officer designated by the head of the agency, and the name and business address of that official.

actor: Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords
actor_quote: Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords
scope_text: when an individual disagrees with the refusal of the agency to amend his record and requests a review of such refusal
scope_quotes: (d) Access to Records.— Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords shall—

(3) permit the individual who disagrees with the refusal of the agency to amend his record to request a review of such refusal, and not later than 30 days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) from the date on which the individual requests such review, complete such review and make a final determination unless, for good cause shown, the head of the agency extends such 30-day period; and if, after his review, the reviewing official also refuses to amend the record in accordance with the request, permit the individual to file with the agency a concise statement setting forth the reasons for his disagreement with the refusal of the agency, and notify the individual of the provisions for judicial review of the reviewing official’s determination under subsection (g)(1)(A) of this section;
summary: Each agency that maintains a system of records must permit an individual who disagrees with the refusal of the agency to amend his record to request a review of such refusal, and not later than 30 days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) from the date on which the individual requests such review, complete such review and make a final determination unless, for good cause shown, the head of the agency extends such 30-day period.
